title: UTMB 2026 official GPX file
claims: The official 2026 UTMB GPX file contains 14,084 track points.
A local raw parse of the official GPX measures 173.83 km.
The raw elevation series in the GPX sums to +10,253 m and −10,252 m.
The GPX elevation range is 805 m to 2,571 m.
The GPX metadata declares copyright to LiveTrail® and links to livetrail.run.
The GPX carries no licence statement that would allow redistribution, so this site links to it instead of copying it.
